reviews.title: Can’t recommend more!
reviews.comment: The build quality is extremely good for its price, it is heavy for a silicone case, the stock cherry profile keycaps are top quality, on top of that, the Reaper switches sound like heaven!
reviews.author: Z.A.

reviews.title: Nicest feeling keyboard
reviews.comment: Absolutely great, my first mechanical keyboard, doesn't make me any better in game, but its better than my dirty ash laptop keyboard
reviews.author: Jhon Mosquera

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.comment: Finally decided to purchase an Aula after so many TikTok ads about these keyboards. Best decision ever, the switches sound super nice, has a bunch of RGB customization options and connectivity options and SUPER STURDY! Feels and weighs perfect, not bad for a keyboard under $100!!
reviews.author: Reviewer

reviews.title: Good budget keyboard
reviews.comment: Good quality switches and etc, but the prints of the keycaps were slightly smudged
reviews.author: Baylenn Soper

reviews.title: SOUNDS SO GOOD
reviews.comment: I got the light blue reaper switch for gaming it is perfect and super affordable and the sound the keys make is sooooo satisfying if you want a nice sounding keyboard get thissss I am addicted to the sound lol
reviews.author: Juliana marie Sites
